mean_peak_tensile_load.instruction: Estimate the mean peak tensile load measured for specimens made with this fused deposition modeling configuration.
mean_peak_tensile_load.field_description: printer_chamber is the open or closed printer type. material names the filament. layer_height_mm is the nominal layer thickness in millimetres. infill_pct is the infill percentage and infill_pattern is its layout. print_speed_mm_per_s is the print speed in millimetres per second. The output is the configuration-level mean of three specimens tested under the source study protocol.
